criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered and staged dark. Five hold up: 5 the best (limb ratios measured 0.553 against 0.551), 8, 9, 7 and 1. Several lean on a default or show an artifact: 4 a stock monitor with a flat mid grey tile field, the most mid tone frame; 3 a pale untextured polygon behind the pod and a flat cyan ring lens; 6 vertical brick seams; 2 primitive trucks under a brown haze; 1 a load that reads as firewood; 8 the label level with the sixth arm.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one accent, one type block, three working continuity devices. Slide 4's interior breaks the value run and slide 2's fog leans warm.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the sources are primary. Three looser phrasings: slide 2's 100 cameras as present fact, slide 6's hook as the city's own description unattributed, and slide 7 setting 473 beside 374 without slide 5's disclaimer. None is a hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns what happened at city level. Who decided to deploy and who holds the termination are not stated, nothing a reader can do, untranslated terms, the close on the city's slogan.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The order works and the turn on 8 is real. The cover is plain, 2 repeats the cover's 50, 4's 5,318 repeats on 5, the close is the subject's own line.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and honest without doom, but a careful briefing summary rather than a Dallas voice, with repeated attributions and Drawn to illustrate on eight deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Same program and courtesy letter beat as no. 31 37 days ago, a white vehicle at last light with a cyan accent as in nos. 46 and 52, lastLight again. The limb rack is fresh.

ship_note: A threshold dissent, not a fault. 6.94 under the round 2 rung of 7.7. No hard fail.
one_sentence_fix: Print on frame 9 the one thing a Dallas resident can act on, the next committee or council date or what to do when a courtesy letter arrives, and name who holds the 10 day termination.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stock monitor in a void, a flat mid grey tile field, the most mid tone frame, reads as a UI screenshot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A dark tile field with only cyan observation tiles lit, the reviewer's shoulder and hand in silhouette at the left, the monitor running off the right edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale untextured polygon behind the pod, flat emissive ring lens.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The boom in dark painted steel or cropped out, a coated glass lens with a highlight and dark pupil.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Vertical brick texture seams and no ground contact.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A continuous UV across the face, contact, grime and lawn blades at the base.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive boxes under a brown haze band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at about 12 m with the three near trucks large, far rows into a near black sky.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The label level with the sixth arm, not the bare seventh arm and tag.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the label down to the bare arm's height left of the upright.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Uniform cut cylinders read as firewood, not curbside brush.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Branched limbs with forks and leaf cards, a few cut ends lit.
